Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    A Roof in Two Days When It Can't Wait

    If it's an emergency, we can have a roof stripped, felted and battened with new tiles in 2 days. A typical job takes us around 4 to 5 days. New roofs.

  2. 02

    15 Years in Business

    Sandon Roofing has 15 years in business behind it, and a team of 9 on the tools today.

  3. 03

    A 10 Year Guarantee

    We offer a 10 year guarantee. Ask us what it covers on your job when we quote.

  4. 04

    A Trained Team

    Between the team we hold City and Guilds, health and safety, first aid, manual handling and construction qualifications.

  5. 05

    The Whole Roof, Top to Bottom

    New roofs, repairs, flat roofs, chimneys, guttering, fascias, soffits and dry verge, plus outside decorating, fencing and power washing. See our services.
